title: Null sets: from compact subsets of U to arbitrary sets (parent step 9)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and μ, ν measures on ℝ^P (Euclid P) such that μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and μ(C) = 0 for every compact C ⊆ U with ν(C) = 0. Then μ(E) = 0 for every E ⊆ ℝ^P with ν(E) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → ν C = 0 → μ C = 0) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), ν E = 0 → μ E = 0
